Roasted Blueberry Quinoa Breakfast Bowls
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, July 26, 2017 - 9:14am

Ingredients




FOR THE ROASTED BLUEBERRIES
2 pounds fresh blueberries
1 tbsp sugar (I used cinnamon flavoured sugar)
FOR THE QUINOA
1 1/2 cups uncooked Quinoa
1 1/2 cups water
1 1/2 cups milk ( I used full fat milk)
1 1/2 tsp chai seasoning(optional

Preparation

1 FOR THE ROASTED BLUEBERRIES 2 Wash and clean blueberries (removing any stems) and let dry slightly on a kitchen towel. 3 Heat the oven to 400º F. 4 Place clean berries in a heat proof baking dish. 5 Add the sugar, and give them a stir. 6 Bake in oven for about 12 minutes, stirring several times. 7 Berries are done when the berries are just about ready to burst open.   8 FOR THE QUINOA 9 Cook according to package directions. 10 I used 1/2 milk and 1/2 water, and added some chai seasoning (optional). 11 Place quinoa in serving bowls, and top with berries. 12 ENJOY!!

About

Roasted Blueberry Quinoa Breakfast Bowls are a healthy, nutritious and totally delicious way to get your morning stared.
